about.heading: ~/about
paragraphs: Dev With Spoon is a developer community built around one idea: programming is easier when it's served in small, digestible bites.

We share tutorials, practical tips and open-source projects for beginners and working developers alike. Whether you're writing your first line of HTML or shipping a full-stack app, you'll find someone here to learn with.
